cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'd like to apply for the Marketing Associate for Clinical Education position in Stryker's Peripheral Vascular division, EMEA. What attracts me is the centre of the role: taking clinical evidence and turning it into content and training that internal teams and healthcare professionals can genuinely use. That's the work I do today in another field, and I want to do it where it has a direct effect on patient care.

At Episto I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and content for client websites, publish and maintain pages and blog posts in WordPress, and track results in Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Search Console. Earlier, at Knowledge Experts, I supported the team in building SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores) and Aras Kargo, and designed and built client websites in WordPress. I also build and maintain a pharmacists' association site with a consistent layout for around 600 member pages, and worked on Shopify store design, catalogues and blog content for two apparel brands. At ViviDoctor in Belgium I developed front-end features for a healthcare web application - my first proper look at how carefully medical software is built, and where my interest in medical technology began.

What I'd bring to Stryker: reliable follow-through on projects with many moving parts, clear writing and formatting for different audiences, and familiarity with the channel mix behind in-person, virtual and on-demand delivery. I'm used to working with stakeholders across markets and cultures, English is fluent and Turkish is my native language.

I don't come from a clinical education background. I'm applying because I'm eager to learn it, and because the content, coordination and communication side of this role is what I do well. I'm happy to travel as the role requires, and I'd welcome a conversation.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok

cv_highlights:
• Content and CMS: SEO blog and website content writing, plus publishing and updating pages, posts and media in WordPress (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math) - the closest match to developing educational content and marketing collateral.
• Project delivery with many moving parts: supported SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores, ERP/POS integration) and Aras Kargo, and built client websites end to end from structure to content.
• Stakeholder communication across markets and cultures: remote collaboration with clients in Belgium and Türkiye; English fluent, Turkish native, Dutch at B1/A2+ level.
• Measuring what works: Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Search Console for tracking and reporting, backed by Semrush SEO, GA4, Google Ads Search and HubSpot Content Marketing certifications.
• Healthcare-adjacent technical grounding: front-end development for a healthcare web application at ViviDoctor (Belgium), plus HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python automation and daily LLM use for research and content.
